01 — About

Still learning.

I’m Tufayel — a Diploma in Civil Technology student with a deep curiosity about technology, IT, software, and the world of digital innovation.

Beyond my academic journey, I enjoy exploring software, experimenting with technology, discovering new tools, and learning how things work behind the scenes. From tech and software to modding and customization, I’m always curious about new ideas and possibilities.

I believe in continuous learning, independent thinking, and personal growth. This website is my own space on the internet — a reflection of who I am, what interests me, and the person I’m working towards becoming.
